title: Number summary
description:
Read whole numbers until the input ends (at most 1000 of them), then print:

```
Count: 5
Smallest: -3
Largest: 12
Average: 4.40
Above average: 3
```

The average has 2 decimals. With no numbers at all, print only `No numbers`. Store the numbers in an array, because "above average" needs a second pass once the average is known.

examples.name: five numbers
examples.expected:
Count: 5
Smallest: -3
Largest: 12
Average: 4.40
Above average: 2

examples.name: one number
examples.expected:
Count: 1
Smallest: 42
Largest: 42
Average: 42.00
Above average: 0

tests.name: five numbers
tests.expected:

Smallest: -3
Largest: 12
Average: 4.40
Above average: 2
